subject: model
value: One row is the full plain-text extraction of exactly one catalogued PDF, held as a 1:1 extension of its documents row.
justification: The DDL is unambiguous: doc_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE. INTEGER PRIMARY KEY is the rowid, so it is non-null and unique in every legal state, and the FK plus cascade makes this a strict vertical partition of documents rather than an independent entity: 149 rows against 149 documents, one per document. The only dependency discovered is doc_id -> text, which is the PK dependency itself; the relation is 4NF with nothing to decompose. text is one archived document body (a whole extracted PDF), not several instances of one fact, and discovery raised no atomicity candidate for it. Scope is current-state because text is the extraction of the file presently at documents.path (all 149 rows have text_ok=1 and text_chars set); re-extracting a replaced PDF overwrites text under the same doc_id. There is no scan_id, version, or timestamp column, so the row asserts what the file contains now, not a history of extractions.

subject: model
value: One row is one content hash that two or more catalogued files share, together with the size of that duplicate group and the list of member paths.
justification: The DDL declares sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY. SQLite leaves that nullable on a rowid table, but the author's intent is plain: the hash identifies the duplicate group, and count and paths_json are derived facts about it (count = len(paths_json)). count and paths_json look unique only because the table holds exactly one row; a second collision of two files would repeat count = 2 immediately, so both are accidental, and the reported 'constant column -> X' BCNF violations are a one-row artifact. The single row is sha256 1a1c2123..., whose two paths are documents ids 189 and 190, byte-identical copies of 'A chiral aperiodic monotile' - the only collision among 149 rows with 148 distinct hashes. A sibling catalog builder, /home/wreckoning90125/polytwister-native/tools/build_hopf_lens_catalog.py (not this authority's builder - its columns are source_count/source_ids_json), inserts into its same-named table only when len(source_ids) > 1, corroborating 'hash shared by two or more files' as the entity. paths_json is a member list kept as one derived group value; no atomicity subject was raised for it. Scope is current-state: an aggregate over the inventory as it stands, recomputed on rescan.
